title: LifeSteal
description: A lightweight Lifesteal plugin built for SMP servers.
body:
# Lifesteal

A lightweight, solo-developed **Lifesteal** plugin designed for SMP servers, bringing high-stakes PvP and survival gameplay to your community.

## Features

* ❤️ **Lose a Heart on Death**
  Each time a player dies, they permanently lose one maximum heart.

* ⚔️ **Gain a Heart on Player Kill**
  Killing another player rewards you with one additional maximum heart.

* ⛔ **14-Day Ban on Heart Depletion**
  Players who lose all of their hearts are automatically banned for **14 days**.

* 🧪 **Revive Crafting Recipe**
  Craft a **Revive Item** to instantly unban a player before their 14-day ban expires, allowing them to rejoin the server.

## Compatibility

* ✅ Tested and fully functional on **Spigot 26.2**.
* ✅ Works reliably on multiplayer servers hosted by providers such as **BisectHosting** and other major hosting services.

## Stability

This plugin has been tested to ensure reliable gameplay in multiplayer environments.

## Updates

The plugin will continue to receive updates over time. Bug reports, suggestions, and feature requests are always welcome, and issues will be addressed as they are identified.
